title: Les Roses: Rosa Lucida (Rosier luisant)
artist: after Pierre-Joseph Redouté (P. J. Redouté pinx.); engraved by Bessin; printed by Rémond; text by C.-A. Thory
medium: stipple and line engraving, printed in colour à la poupée, finished by hand
institution: The Cleveland Museum of Art, Mr. and Mrs. Charles G. Prasse Collection, 1965.290 (the museum's record names Henri Joseph Redouté; the plate is signed P. J. Redouté pinx.)
license: CC0 (Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access)
notes: rose.webp is the scan resampled to 2000 px wide. The other files are our separation of it: the watercolour layer, the paper, the engraved dots (found one by one in the 400 dpi scan), the poupée and wash maps.
